title: DarkMusic 1.5.23 Release
changelog:
• Accurate Play Count & Most Played: Real-time play count tracking across playback, gapless transitions, and intelligence analytics; Most Played section strictly reflects actual listening history.
• Sleek Capsule Navigation & Mini Player: Reduced height and refined corner radius for a more compact and elegant floating capsule bar.
• 7-Tier Prioritized Homepage: Jump Back In, Recently Played, Most Played, Songs, Recently Added, Downloads, and Browse Your Collection.
• Pure AMOLED Black Theme: Preserves pure black contrast across the app.
• 120Hz Lyrics Scrolling & Top 50% Anchor: Ultra-smooth synced lyrics with top-anchored ended lyrics.
• Silent Update: Available on-demand when checked manually in Settings > About.
releaseNotes: v1.5.23: Accurate play count & most played tracking, compact capsule navigation & mini player, and 7-tier prioritized homepage hierarchy.
